page_title: MAL 3-2 BIL | Mallorca v Athletic Bilbao 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' A pass from Izeta (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Leo Roman and the move breaks down.
90+8' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
90+7' Mallorca take a short corner kick.

90+6' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort. Mallorca get a corner.
90+6' Surely that's handball by one of the Mallorca players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+5' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
90+4' Jose Guzman blows his whistle and it's Javier Llabres (Mallorca) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+3' Sergi Darder comes off the pitch to be replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
90' We will have 11 min. of added time.
89' 7:9 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
87' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
86' The referee blows his whistle as Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge.

84' Leo Roman pulls off a decent save! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
83' Here comes a substitution. Jan Virgili is given a rest as he is replaced by Pablo Torre (Mallorca).
83' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Toni Lato will be replaced by Johan Mojica (Mallorca).
81' The Ath Bilbao players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch for Jesus Areso.
76' That's the end of the game for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta, who is replaced by Izeta (Ath Bilbao).
73' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
73' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Mateo Joseph is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nico Williams walks off the pitch to be replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
72' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) receives a red card and walks off the field of play!
70' A second caution from Jose Guzman for Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) means that he has to leave the pitch early today. It's a red card.
69' 3 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Unai Simon no chance!
69' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is going to take the penalty!
68' It’s a PENALTY to Mallorca after the VAR review!
66' There's a break in play and referee Jose Guzman must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Mallorca using VAR. This could be interesting!
65' Surely that's handball by one of the Ath Bilbao players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
63' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
61' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
59' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) replaces Unai Gomez.
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alex Berenguer as he is replaced by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao).
59' The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.

58' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
56' Ath Bilbao players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
54' Jose Guzman blows the whistle, Toni Lato (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul.
52' 8:13 – the total goal attempt statistics.
50' Ath Bilbao are seeing far more of the ball now.
48' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
47' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+6' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Guzman had an easy-decision to make.
45+5' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45+4' Ball possession – 50:50.
45+2' Ath Bilbao exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
45' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 2 Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a super pass into the box and shoots into the top right corner. What a nice goal!
44' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
42' 2 - 1 Goal 2:1! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
42' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Unai Simon leaps out to thwart his attempt.
41' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
40' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
40' The Mallorca players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
39' Referee Jose Guzman makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Mallorca. Let’s see what happens!
37' That looked a certain handball by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
35' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
34' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
32' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Unai Simon.
30' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Guzman interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
29' Total attempts – 2:9.
27' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
23' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
22' Toni Lato (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' Some great controlled play and passing from Mallorca. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Marash Kumbulla (Mallorca) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

17' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Leo Roman blocks the shot with his legs.
16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
15' The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' The ball possession is 54:46.
13' A player from Ath Bilbao commits a rough challenge. Jose Guzman blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
12' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
10' Mallorca are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
8' 1 - 1 Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
7' Ath Bilbao string together a series of short passes.

5' 1 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Sergi Darder picks out an unmarked Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
3' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
2' The goalkeeper dives to deny Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
1' The match has just started.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Jose Guzman will referee today's match.
